regions.name: TarragØn
regions.blurb: The corrupted three-realm western throne
regions.lore: TarragØn is the united western kingdom formed from Dsärr, Edresan and Yán. Zuläch rules the corrupted realm as Saar’s living vessel, while the land fractures beneath volcanic heat and spreading blight.

regions.name: Dsärr
regions.blurb: The ancient heart-realm of TarragØn
regions.lore: Dsärr lies directly beneath the TarragØn throne and forms the old heartland of the united western kingdom. Once ruled by Zhäro, it is now enclosed within Zuläch’s corrupted domain.

regions.name: Edresan
regions.blurb: The north-eastern coastal realm within TarragØn
regions.lore: Edresan occupies TarragØn’s north-eastern coast, facing the Enën Sea. Qadril’s realm supplied ambition, intrigue and coastal access to the alliance that created the western throne.

regions.name: Yán
regions.blurb: The scorched southern realm within TarragØn
regions.lore: Yán lies south of Dsärr within TarragØn’s western mass. Domiyán’s realm is isolated by scorched terrain and remains bound to the corruption emanating from Saar’s prison.

regions.name: Vulcaria
regions.blurb: Side realm of ash, fire and geothermal highlands
regions.lore: Vulcaria is a volcanic island realm north of the central lands. Queen Olorus governs caldera settlements, geothermal nesting grounds and fire-adapted communities, while wild Gortusks roam its ash highlands.

regions.name: Ame’xore
regions.blurb: Northern island kingdom of hidden archives
regions.lore: Ame’xore lies north of Dreonathen and Kithren as a secluded island kingdom. Queen Teri’itaria’s archives preserve forbidden accounts of Saar, the Sundering, TarragØn and the Old Treaty.

regions.name: Brigachian
regions.blurb: The icy northern sea frontier
regions.lore: Brigachian guards the frozen waters north of Aeyantis. Its icebound coastline and watch harbours monitor the routes where Megalore and other leviathans threaten passing vessels.

regions.name: The Amber Isles
regions.blurb: Small islands between the northern and eastern realms
regions.lore: The Amber Isles divide the northern shipping lanes between Ame’xore, Brigachian and Aeyantis. Their sheltered anchorages support traders, messengers and vessels avoiding the open northern currents.

regions.name: Aeyantis
regions.blurb: Radiant eastern kingdom and beginning of the journey
regions.lore: Queen Ahris rules Aeyantis from its radiant eastern capital. Lumyrion is awakened here and entrusted to the bearer before the westward journey towards TarragØn begins.

regions.name: Crown’s Gate Isles
regions.blurb: Eastern trade hub and maritime enclave
regions.lore: Crown’s Gate Isles sit between Aeyantis and Katzh, controlling a narrow network of ports and sea lanes used by merchants, envoys and royal vessels.

regions.name: Katzh
regions.blurb: The Crownland of law and trade
regions.lore: Katzh occupies a rugged central-eastern island and acts as the commercial crossroads of the Six Crowns. Its laws, harbours and trade networks stabilise travel across the Enën Sea.

regions.name: Dreonathen
regions.blurb: The fortified central realm known as the Last Shield
regions.lore: Dreonathen stands between the eastern Crownlands and the western corruption. King Diogenes commands its rocky plains, roads and fortresses as the final organised defence before TarragØn.

regions.name: Kithren
regions.blurb: The broad mistwood queendom
regions.lore: Kithren is a thick forest realm of ancient trees, wet valleys and persistent ground fog. Queen Keisth rules its hidden settlements while Ly’cara packs move through the misted woods.

regions.name: Mountains of Shal’Mur
regions.blurb: Mountain prison of Saar and site of the Eternal Pillars
regions.lore: The Mountains of Shal’Mur rise between TarragØn and Kithren. Beneath the range lies Saar’s prison, held by the four Eternal Chains forged during the Sundering.

regions.name: Pillar of Order
regions.blurb: The chain that restrains chaos
regions.lore: Order is the first Eternal Chain. It anchors reality against Saar’s unmaking and prevents the prison beneath Shal’Mur from collapsing into chaos.

regions.name: Pillar of Will
regions.blurb: The fractured chain that resists corruption
regions.lore: Will is the damaged Eternal Chain shattered by Zuläch. Its fracture allowed Saar’s essence to enter him, transforming the western king into a living vessel of corruption.

regions.name: Pillar of Form
regions.blurb: The chain that prevents manifestation
regions.lore: Form prevents Saar from taking complete physical shape within the world. While it remains intact, Saar must act through corrupted creatures and living vessels.

regions.name: Pillar of Veil
regions.blurb: The hidden chain of concealment and containment
regions.lore: Veil conceals and contains Saar’s prison. Caelthior was lost while completing this final chain during the Sundering, leaving Lumyrion as the surviving Guardian.

regions.name: The Sundried Atolls
regions.blurb: Ancient ruins scattered across shallow southern waters
regions.lore: The Sundried Atolls contain weathered foundations and ruined structures left exposed to salt, wind and changing tides.

regions.name: The Whispering Reefs
regions.blurb: A dangerous maze of reefs and hidden channels
regions.lore: The Whispering Reefs conceal wrecks, narrow passages and secret anchorages. Sailors avoid them after dark, when unfamiliar voices are said to travel across the water.

regions.name: Southwind Expanse
regions.blurb: Remote and lightly charted southern waters
regions.lore: The Southwind Expanse is a broad outer sea beyond the main Crown routes. Its islands and currents remain only partially mapped.

regions.name: The Duskreach
regions.blurb: A shadow-blighted realm beyond the known roads
regions.lore: The Duskreach is a remote violet-black territory where unnatural energy stains the mountains and sea. It lies outside the principal journey but reflects the wider instability spreading through the world.

regions.name: Leviathan Depths
regions.blurb: Abyssal waters inhabited by immense predators
regions.lore: The Leviathan Depths are trench waters south-west of the Duskreach. Mariners report enormous shapes moving beneath the currents and avoid the region whenever possible.
